verdict.rationale: Cooley GO publicly offers free document generators covering every category in the story. There is a Delaware incorporation package (certificate of incorporation, bylaws, RSPA, 83(b)), a free YC Safe generator in several versions, a Series Seed generator that includes a term sheet, and a mutual NDA form. An independent Hacker News comment confirms the site offers both form templates and document generators for startups. missing for 10: an explicit statement that no client engagement or account is required, and NDA coverage beyond a single UK mutual form title.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client
